definitions.explanation: The part of the face above the eyebrows and below the hairline.

examples.japanese: ⟦{熱|ねつ}→熱：01690_netsu⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧か{額|ひたい}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{触|さわ}って→触る：00808_sawaru⟧⟦{確|たし}かめた→確かめる：01955_tashikameru⟧。
examples.english: I touched their forehead to check if they had a fever.

examples.japanese: {額|ひたい}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{広|ひろ}い→広い：00704_hiroi⟧。
{額|ひたい}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦しわ→皺：05124_shiwa⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{寄|よ}せて→寄せる：02329_yoseru⟧⟦{考|かんが}えている→考える：00856_kangaeru⟧。
examples.english: He's thinking with a furrowed brow.
examples.notes: {額|ひたい}に⟦しわ→皺：05124_shiwa⟧を⟦{寄|よ}せる→寄せる：02329_yoseru⟧ = to furrow one's brow

examples.japanese: ⟦{母|はは}→母：00549_haha⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{額|ひたい}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{手|て}→手：00569_te⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{当|あ}てて→当てる：01864_ateru⟧⟦{熱|ねつ}→熱：01690_netsu⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{測|はか}って→測る：01977_hakaru⟧くれた。⟦{子供|こども}→子供：00554_kodomo⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{頃|ころ}→〜ころ：03091_koro⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{体温計|たいおんけい}→体温計：05484_taionkei⟧⟦より→より：09476_yori⟧⟦{母|はは}→母：00549_haha⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{手|て}→手：00569_te⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{方|ほう}→方：01139_hou⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{安心|あんしん}→安心：01288_anshin⟧した。
examples.english: My mother placed her hand on my forehead to check my temperature. As a child, her hand was more reassuring than a thermometer.

notes:
USAGE: {額|ひたい} specifically refers to the forehead. Note that {額|がく} can also be read as がく meaning 'amount' or 'frame'.

COMMON PATTERNS:
- {額|ひたい}に⟦{汗|あせ}→汗：02173_ase⟧をかく (to sweat on the forehead)
- {額|ひたい}を⟦{触|さわ}る→触る：00808_sawaru⟧ (to touch the forehead)
- {額|ひたい}が⟦{広|ひろ}い→広い：00704_hiroi⟧ (to have a wide forehead)
- {額|ひたい}に⟦しわ→皺：05124_shiwa⟧を⟦{寄|よ}せる→寄せる：02329_yoseru⟧ (to furrow one's brow)

COMMON EXPRESSIONS:
- {額|ひたい}に⟦{汗|あせ}→汗：02173_ase⟧して⟦{働|はたら}く→働く：00503_hataraku⟧ (to work hard, lit. 'work with sweat on one's brow')
- ⟦{猫|ねこ}→猫：02237_neko⟧の{額|ひたい} (a tiny space, lit. 'a cat's forehead')

BODY PARTS:
- ⟦{頭|あたま}→頭：00574_atama⟧ - head
- ⟦{顔|かお}→顔：00558_kao⟧ - face
- ⟦{眉毛|まゆげ}→眉毛：05292_mayuge⟧ - eyebrow
- ⟦{目|め}→目：00525_me⟧ - eye

NOTE: The kanji {額|ひたい} is read as ひたい for 'forehead' but がく for 'amount' (⟦{金額|きんがく}→金額：02665_kingaku⟧) or 'frame' (⟦{額縁|がくぶち}→額縁：16183_gakubuchi⟧).
